title: Transformation and immobilization of sedimental galena (PbS) by phosphate from surface runoff in simulated storm suspensions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00329F, Paper
Yi-Pin Lin, Ze-Xuan Tan
Sedimental galena (PbS) is an important sink for lead in natural waters. Resuspension of PbS caused by storm disturbance can lead to its oxidative dissolution, resulting in higher ecological risks....
